newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 4.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- The chairman of the ruling New Korea Party, Lee Hoi-chang, on Sunday publicly expressed regrets for the controversy surrounding his two sons' exemption from military service.

- President Kim Young-sam is expected to replace eigth to nine ministers in his cabinet on Monday or Tuesday to create a more politically neutral administration ahead of December presidential elections.
- The financially troubled Kia Group said it had raised 155 billion won in emergency operation funds by selling its real estate and other assets.
- The fate of the ailing Kia Group has finally come down to whether or not Kim Sun-hong, the chairman of Kia Group, will give up his managerial rights.
